info.title: PitSeeder
info.description: Command-line tool for seeding, exporting, and querying JsonPit data stores. Supports WWWA foreign key resolution, JSON export to file or stdout, piping to jq, and read-only audit of JsonPit recovery events.

options.name: --source
options.description:    source file for import (JSON or JSON5)

options.name: --json
options.description:    export to stdout (for piping to jq, grep, etc.)

options.name: --at
options.description:    project export history at an offset-explicit ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --wwwa
options.description:    operate on all 4 pits (Person, Object, Place, Activity)

options.name: --window
options.description:    keep the activity window until timeout

options.name: --id-exists
options.description:    seed only: require every ID to exist in living state

options.name: --patch
options.description:
   alias for --id-exists
 PitName           pit to operate on or seed target (e.g., Activity)
